query: What formal causal diagrams (DAGs/SEM) best represent memory writes as mediators of later sign-use, and what minimal covariates must we record to support identification under randomized write/read interventions?

response.query: What formal causal diagrams (DAGs/SEM) best represent memory writes as mediators of later sign-use, and what minimal covariates must we record to support identification under randomized write/read interventions?
